title: PRP injections for face and scalp
what: A little blood is taken from your vein. Plasma is prepared from it and injected into the skin of your face or scalp.
why: To improve the look of the skin or for hair loss, as decided by the doctor.
duration: the procedure usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; a course is usually several sessions, and the effect shows after a few weeks
tell_doctor: If you are pregnant or breastfeeding
If you have skin inflammation or a cold right now

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no fatty food for a few hours before. You can drink water. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop on your own. Tell the doctor what you take, and the doctor will decide.

prepare.title: Hair
prepare.text: For the scalp, you are usually asked to come with clean hair and no styling products.

steps: Blood is drawn from your vein into a tube
The tube is spun in a machine and the plasma separates
The skin is cleaned and treated with an antiseptic
The doctor gives many tiny injections of plasma
feel: Afterward, redness and slight swelling, usually for 1 to 2 days
after: Usually 1 to 2 days with no makeup, sauna or pool
After scalp treatment, usually do not wash your hair until the next day. Ask the doctor
Do not touch the injection spots with your hands
Next session at the time the doctor sets
red_flags: Severe pain, swelling and redness getting worse
Pimples with pus or fever above 38
Swelling of the face or lips, trouble breathing: call your local emergency number

faq.q: Is it safe? It's my own blood, right?
faq.a: Yes, your own plasma is used, so allergy is very rare. But sterile conditions matter.

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: Usually after a few weeks and after a course of several sessions.

reminders.text: PRP injections tomorrow. No alcohol today. Have a light breakfast without fatty food in the morning. You can drink water.
